message.content:
{
  "summary": "Soda ash solution tank level (LIT-901) is falling fast at -14.8 change over 60 minutes, with the level currently at 18.3 %. The likely cause is a drain or flush valve left open or passing, a dissolving system fault, or a level transmitter fault.",
  "likely_causes": [
    "A drain or flush valve on the tank left open or passing.",
    "Dissolving system fault: soda ash or salt silo empty, feeder blocked, or make-up water valve closed.",
    "Level transmitter fault."
  ],
  "checks": [
    "Compare the level transmitter with the tank sight glass.",
    "Walk the tank bund for an open drain valve or leak.",
    "Check the silo level, the screw feeder and the make-up water valve of the dissolving system.",
    "Check the solution strength with the conductivity or density check before batches resume."
  ],
  "handover": "Active alarm for soda ash tank level falling fast (LIT-901) at 18.3 %. Conducted checks on the tank bund and dissolving system to identify any leaks, open valves, or dissolving faults.",
  "citations": [
    "SOP-13 13.3",
    "SOP-13 13.4",
    "SOP-13 13.2",
    "SOP-13 13.5"
  ]
}
